content.title: 1 Small-Cap Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 We Find Risky

content.title: How Recent Analyst Resets Are Reframing The Leslie's (LESL) Investment Story
content.summary: Leslie's latest analyst reset has been harsh, with model fair value estimates moving from about US$8.90 to roughly US$5.53 and published price targets shifting down to US$5 from US$20 after the company issued new earnings results and guidance. That swing reflects revenue assumptions that now move from a 56.6% growth outlook to a 73.2% decline, as analysts bring expectations closer to what they see in the current guidance and execution.
